title: She comes back for the shock absorbers: the assistant prices and hands over, the junior operator takes the chat; at T her answer is unread and a draft waits
demonstrates: The live-demo chat. A returning visitor asks to book the deferred work. The assistant answers from the public price list, cannot book, hands over; from Maya's first line the chat is hers and the assistant only drafts. Thirty minutes before T the customer writes again: the chat is open, owned by slot 6, unread, with one draft in the box that is honest about what the assistant cannot see. Editing it (two free times, the total with tax) and sending it is the demo.

scenario.who_writes: The same customer, from the same phone, 16 days after her visit.
scenario.wants: To book the rear shock absorbers she declined, and to know the total.
scenario.what_happens: Thursday 15:40 she asks the price and for a day next week. The assistant gives the price-list figure and hands over. Maya replies at 16:05 with two times. She does not answer that day. Friday at 10:00 she writes that neither time works and asks for Wednesday or Thursday early, and for the total with tax. The assistant drafts; nobody has opened it at T.

facts.expected_reply: two free times at main in the next seven days and the price: 339.28 plus shop supplies, 379.51 with tax (card S07, question S7.3)
facts.note: The Thursday she asks about is the stocktake day (S13): the shop closes at noon, so only its morning is free.

prices.what: rear shock absorbers, pair, class car, standard parts, today's list

T-1d.anchor: slot 6's last working day before T
T-1d.what: the return chat, 15:40; slot 6 replies at 16:05

T.what: she writes again 30 minutes before T

T+6d.what: 'thurs'; the stocktake day: every shop closes at 12:00

timeline.text: hi again its Rachel Dunlap with the CRV. im ready to do those rear shocks
what was the price again and can i get in next week

Hi Rachel, welcome back! On our price list, replacing the rear shock absorbers as a pair is $339.28 for a car like the CR-V, before shop supplies and tax; the service desk has your exact estimate. I can't book a time myself, so I'll pass this to East Main and they'll confirm a day with you. Is (423) 555-0131 still the right number?
Thank you. Your request is with the team now, and somebody will get back to you as soon as possible.

truth.reason: to book or ask for a slot
truth.handled: assistant first, handed over (scheduling), slot 6; then drafts
truth.outcome: open at T, owned by slot 6, unread, one unsent draft
facts: she asked on slot 6's last working day before T to book the rear shock absorbers she had declined
the assistant gave the list price, 339.28 before shop supplies and tax, and handed over
slot 6 offered drop-offs on Monday at 8:00 or Tuesday at 8:30; she cannot come either day and asks for Wednesday or Thursday early and for the total with tax
the right answer offers two free times and the price: 339.28 plus supplies, 379.51 with tax

why: The draft says what the assistant knows (the list price) and promises only to find out the rest; the junior's edit is the two times and the total.
Maya's 16:05 line has no price in it: the time comes first, and the price had just been given.
At T this is one of the two chats that wait on the shop, and both are web chats.
new_facts: Maya offered drop-offs on the Monday of week W+1 at 8:00 and the Tuesday at 8:30; the customer is out of town on both days.
A shock-absorber job is spoken of as 'about an hour and a half' (catalogue: 1.2 billed hours).
